text:
paul-marketing: Quick thread  new idea to reduce inbox fatigue during launch week: put benchmark narrative and webinar invites on separate lanes and add behavior-based hold windows. Outline below.
anya-growth: Love it. We lost people last time when they got 3 emails in 6 days. What's the lane proposal?
sophia-analytics: FWIW numbers: paid_trial_new ~9.3k, conference_leads ~1.6k. Overlap (>=2 marketing sends in 5 days) ~11.2%. SQL used in analysis included in doc.
paul-marketing: Lane proposal: Launch-news (D0), Educational drip (D2, D5), Benchmark (D9 for paid; D12 for conference), Webinar invite (D18 global) unless sales_contacted=true. Add a 72h "recently engaged" hold: any open or event -> delay next send by +5 days.
rita-campaigns: Implementation: create suppression list 'hold_recent_engaged_v3' in SendGrid and wire Braze to consult it before enqueuing sends. Example payload change:
```
{"template":"bench_v5","delay":9,"suppressions":["hold_recent_engaged_v3","sales_contacted"]}
```
lee-sales: Confirm sales_contacted flag is reliable? We update from SFDC via webhook but latency can be ~5-10m. If timing is tight, we should add an extra check to avoid race conditions.
mike-ops: Ops note: respect billing blackout (24h) and global locale windows (no sends between 22:00-06:00 user local). Also will add IAM for the new suppression list.
sophia-analytics: A/B test suggestion: For paid_trial_new test Benchmark at D9 vs D13, 20% randomization. Metrics: 7d unsub, reg-rate, 21d demo. I'll provision cohorts and expected sample sizes.
anya-growth: Also test subject line variants for benchmark: variant A = "Benchmark: how teams cut inference cost" vs B = "New benchmark: real infra wins you can copy". 50/50 within each timing arm.
rita-campaigns: I'll stage flows in staging and do a 500-recipient dry send to validate suppression logic and templates tomorrow.
paul-marketing: Owners: Anya (test design + subjects), Rita (flows + staging), Sophia (cohorts + metrics), Mike (ops + blackout/IAM), Lee (sales flag). Target deploy: next Mon. calendar-bot: Event created: marketing/sends/launch-week-lane-split at 2026-04-12T09:00:00Z
lee-sales: I'll run a smoke check on SFDC sync and report back by EOD.
sophia-analytics: Uploaded cohort CSVs and expected reach numbers to the campaign doc. Net send drop estimated ~13% for paid cohort after suppression.
paul-marketing: Great. We'll review dry-send results in #marketing tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
